name: Without Romance
source:
A loveless girl's fairy tale wish

Her fairy tale life laid out before her, Risa’s eyes are set on the future. With thoughts of her family spurring her on, will she earn a place beside Ren Yamato, Prince Charming himself? The turmoil in her heart knows life is rarely so straight forward.

[From [url=https://moonlitworks.itch.io/nomance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个不曾拥有爱情的女孩，许下童话般的愿望。

童话般的人生已在眼前铺开，莉纱的目光投向了未来。家人的身影激励着她，她能在宛如白马王子的Ren Yamato身边，争得属于自己的一席之地吗？她内心的波澜却提醒着她，生活很少如此顺遂。

[摘自[url=https://moonlitworks.itch.io/nomance]itch.io[/url]]
